component.name: ZeusPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.th = LumenTheme() m.top.visible = false m.X = 1220 m.W = 660 m.dim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.dim.id = "zeusDim" m.dim.width = 1920 m.dim.height = 1080 m.panel = m.top.createChild("Group") m.panel.id = "zeusPanel" m.panel.translation = [m.X, 40] bg = m.panel.createChild("Poster") bg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/sheet_r44.9.png" bg.blendColor = m.th.paper bg.width = m.W bg.height = 1000
mark = m.panel.createChild("Poster") mark.uri = "pkg:/images/brand/zeus_mark_72.png" mark.translation = [40, 40] mark.width = 72 mark.height = 72 t = m.panel.createChild("Label") t.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Title", 52) t.color = m.th.ink t.text = "Zeus" t.translation = [130, 34] t.width = 400 t.height = 64 s = m.panel.createChild("Label") s.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 22) s.color = m.th.ink60 s.text = "Your TV's assistant" s.translation = [132, 92] s.width = 400 s.height = 30
' Conversation: bottom-aligned between y=150 and y=740 (panel coordinates). m.chat = m.panel.createChild("Group") m.chat.clippingRect = [0, 150, m.W, 590] m.messages = []
m.chipRow = m.panel.createChild("Group") m.chipRow.translation = [40, 760] m.chips = []
' Input bar. m.bar = m.panel.createChild("Group") m.bar.translation = [40, 880] m.barBg = m.bar.createChild("Poster") m.barBg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" m.barBg.width = m.W - 80 m.barBg.height = 76 m.barL = m.bar.createChild("Label") m.barL.font = LumenFont("Manrope-SemiBold", 25) m.barL.text = "Ask Zeus anything…" m.barL.translation = [30, 0] m.barL.width = m.W - 140 m.barL.height = 76 m.barL.vertAlign = "center"
m.focusRow = "chips" m.chipIndex = 0
m.anim = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.anim.duration = 0.28 m.anim.easeFunction = "outQuad" m.dimI = m.anim.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.dimI.fieldToInterp = "zeusDim.opacity" m.dimI.key = [0, 1] m.slideI = m.anim.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.slideI.fieldToInterp = "zeusPanel.translation" m.slideI.key = [0, 1] m.fadeI = m.anim.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeI.fieldToInterp = "zeusPanel.opacity" m.fadeI.key = [0, 1] m.anim.observeField("state", "onAnim")
setChips(["What should I watch?", "Paint me something sunny", "Sleep in 30 min", "Volume up a bit"]) addMessage("zeus", "Hi, I'm Zeus. Happy to fetch an app, change the painting or set a sleep timer.") end sub
sub onDeep() m.dim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.45) end sub
sub onOpen() m.anim.control = "stop" if m.top.open m.top.visible = true m.focusRow = "chips" m.chipIndex = 0 paintFocus() m.dimI.keyValue = [0, 1] m.slideI.keyValue = [[m.X + 60, 40], [m.X, 40]] m.fadeI.keyValue = [0, 1] else m.dimI.keyValue = [1, 0] m.slideI.keyValue = [[m.X, 40], [m.X + 60, 40]] m.fadeI.keyValue = [1, 0] end if m.anim.control = "start" end sub
sub onAnim() if m.anim.state = "stopped" and not m.top.open then m.top.visible = false end sub
' role: "user" | "zeus". Keeps the last six for history; shows what fits. function addMessage(role as string, text as string) as boolean m.messages.Push({ role: role, text: text }) while m.messages.Count() > 10 m.messages.Shift() end while renderChat() return true end function
function history() as object out = [] for each msg in m.messages out.Push({ role: msg.role, text: msg.text }) end for return out end function
' Bottom-aligned chat, newest last. Bubble heights come from wrapping the words ourselves ' (Label.boundingRect isn't reliable for wrapped text here), so whole messages show. sub renderChat() if m.chat = invalid then return m.chat.removeChildrenIndex(m.chat.getChildCount(), 0) items = [] for each msg in m.messages items.Push(msg) end for if m.top.thinking then items.Push({ role: "zeus", text: "…" }) maxW = 500 lineH = 34 y = 740 for i = items.Count() - 1 to 0 step -1 it = items[i] wrap = wrapText(it.text, maxW - 44) lines = wrap.lines if lines > 9 then lines = 9 h = lines * lineH + 32 w = wrap.width + 44 if lines > 1 then w = maxW if w < 90 then w = 90 if w > maxW then w = maxW y = y - h - 12 ' The oldest message that only partly fits is skipped rather than cut in half. if y < 150 then exit for g = m.chat.createChild("Group") if it.role = "user" then x = m.W - 40 - w else x = 40 g.translation = [x, y] b = g.createChild("Poster") b.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/bubble_r28.9.png" b.width = w b.height = h l = g.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Manrope-SemiBold", 24) l.text = it.text l.translation = [22, 16] l.width = w - 44 l.height = h - 32 l.wrap = true l.maxLines = 9 l.lineSpacing = 4 if it.role = "user" b.blendColor = m.th.ink l.color = m.th.white else b.blendColor = m.th.white l.color = m.th.ink end if end for end sub
' Greedy word wrap with an estimated Manrope 24 width per character. ' Returns { lines, width } (width = widest line, for one-line bubbles). function wrapText(text as string, maxW as integer) as object lines = 0 widest = 0 for each para in text.Split(Chr(10)) lineW = 0 lines = lines + 1 for each word in para.Split(" ") ww = textWidth(word) space = 0 if lineW > 0 then space = 7 if lineW > 0 and lineW + space + ww > maxW if lineW > widest then widest = lineW lines = lines + 1 lineW = ww else lineW = lineW + space + ww end if ' A single word longer than the line wraps by itself. while lineW > maxW lines = lines + 1 lineW = lineW - maxW widest = maxW end while end for if lineW > widest then widest = lineW end for return { lines: lines, width: widest } end function
function textWidth(word as string) as integer w = 0 for i = 1 to Len(word) c = Mid(word, i, 1) if InStr(1, "il.,:;'!|", c) > 0 w = w + 6 else if InStr(1, "mwMW@", c) > 0 w = w + 20 else if c >= "A" and c <= "Z" w = w + 16 else w = w + 13 end if end for return w end function
function setChips(list as object) as boolean m.chipRow.removeChildrenIndex(m.chipRow.getChildCount(), 0) m.chips = [] x = 0 y = 0 for each c in list g = m.chipRow.createChild("Group") bg = g.createChild("Poster") bg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" bg.height = 56 ring = g.createChild("Poster") ring.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64_stroke.9.png" ring.height = 56 ring.blendColor = m.th.ink l = g.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 23) l.text = c l.height = 56 l.vertAlign = "center" l.translation = [22, 0] tw = l.boundingRect().width if tw <= 0 then tw = Len(c) * 12 l.width = tw + 2 w = tw + 44 bg.width = w ring.width = w if x + w > m.W - 80 x = 0 y = y + 66 end if g.translation = [x, y] x = x + w + 10 m.chips.Push({ bg: bg, ring: ring, label: l, text: c }) end for m.chipIndex = 0 paintFocus() return true end function
sub paintFocus() for i = 0 to m.chips.Count() - 1 c = m.chips[i] f = (m.focusRow = "chips" and i = m.chipIndex) if f c.bg.blendColor = m.th.ink c.bg.opacity = 1 c.label.color = m.th.white else c.bg.blendColor = m.th.white c.bg.opacity = 1 c.label.color = m.th.ink end if end for if m.focusRow = "bar" m.barBg.blendColor = m.th.ink m.barL.color = m.th.white else m.barBg.blendColor = m.th.white m.barL.color = WithAlpha(m.th.ink, 0.55) end if end sub
function handleKey(key as string) as boolean if m.focusRow = "chips" if key = "left" and m.chipIndex > 0 then m.chipIndex = m.chipIndex - 1 if key = "right" and m.chipIndex < m.chips.Count() - 1 then m.chipIndex = m.chipIndex + 1 if key = "down" or m.chips.Count() = 0 then m.focusRow = "bar" if key = "OK" and m.chips.Count() > 0 then m.top.ask = m.chips[m.chipIndex].text else if key = "up" and m.chips.Count() > 0 then m.focusRow = "chips" if key = "OK" then openKeyboard() end if paintFocus() return true end function
sub openKeyboard() kb = CreateObject("roSGNode", "StandardKeyboardDialog") kb.title = "Ask Zeus" kb.message = ["Try: open YouTube, volume down a lot, sleep in an hour"] kb.buttons = ["Ask", "Cancel"] kb.observeField("buttonSelected", "onKeyboard") m.kb = kb m.top.getScene().dialog = kb end sub
sub onKeyboard() text = m.kb.text chosen = m.kb.buttonSelected m.kb.close = true m.kb = invalid if chosen = 0 and text <> invalid and text.Trim() <> "" then m.top.ask = text.Trim() end sub
